text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. A Grand Prix truly 
worthy of deciding the strongest of the 
year."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is a care package. From 
Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I was sure you'd be racing today too. You 
really okay just watching from the 
sidelines?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, not just yet. Since I lost the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup, I want to use today to 
gather my strength.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And so I can win the next time we face 
off, too!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So don't you go losing easily either. Even 
if it's against the senior I respect.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want my rival to be so great that 
they can even surpass the person I respect 
most—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAH! TEIO!! YOU'RE the undisputed 
championnn!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ It just made me want to race 
against you too~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now, show me your magic once more. Who is 
stronger: those from the Classic Triple 
Crown route, or those from the Triple 
Tiara route?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The strong ones are just plain strong!!
